name: voronoi-bubble
description: Create easy Voronoi treemap HTML with optional semantic position hints.

interface.shortDescription: Generate readable Voronoi treemap HTML examples.
interface.longDescription: Helps ChatGPT, Codex, and coding agents turn tidy-style flat rows into easy Voronoi treemap examples with VoronoiBubble, including direct group/subgroup/item/size mapping, semantic position hints such as UMAP coordinates, simple group colors, positive/negative sentiment colormaps, label-overlap-aware rendering, CDN-based single-file HTML, local bundle variants, and popup templates.
defaultPrompt: Create a Voronoi treemap HTML chart from this data with click popups.
Map these columns to group, subgroup, item, and size for VoronoiBubble.
Generate an offline VoronoiBubble HTML example using the local UMD bundle.
